scope: Shared dominant-body flight read model and native speed/altitude, air/load/orbit and subsystem readouts; no new physics, shader, dependency or wire payload.

contract.ownership: flight-authority::instruments borrows existing authority kinematics, OsculatingElements, navball frame math and the existing canopy adoption validator. Both decks consume it; no independent flight, atmosphere, orbit propagator or target model.
contract.epoch: Newest authority state/time, never interpolated render coordinates; dominant-body display hint does not mutate reference body, state, gravity or controls. Matching-home-terrain AGL only; acoustics keeps the source's reference atmosphere.
contract.frames: Native HUD-session Surface/Air/Orbital/Target speed/cue and Datum/AGL choices do not edit flight or graphics requests. The attitude grid stays local, spacecraft vertical/horizontal decomposition stays surface-referenced, missing input suppresses speed/tapes/cues. No target input is supplied yet.
contract.foreign_body: Surface explicitly falls back to dominant-body-relative velocity where no rotation provider is installed. No launch-body rotation/air/terrain is applied there. The local grid uses the baked system's polar axis, not a fabricated foreign rotation measurement.
contract.provenance: Replica last_forces reconstructed by display_loads is not a server observation: air, thrust/TWR and g-load remain unavailable. Actual wheel torque and checked canopy observations are retained from the newest accepted snapshot. Rejected canopy vectors become unavailable instead of reusing previous/local replica loads.
contract.diagnostics: Ap/Pe are instantaneous two-body diagnostics, not JIT futures or solved impacts. TWR retains the pilot's central-body gravity reference. g-load is non-gravitational force / mass / standard gravity. These do not change simulation laws.

verification.other_gates: fmt, workspace all-features Clippy, native feature-off Clippy, architecture check, release viewer/server build, diff check, muted 8-presentation Wayland flight/HUD smoke, muted 1280x800 headless flight-deck capture
verification.cost_scenario: release, 64 craft x100 passes; 1185.217/1045.192 us per batch. Single-run read-model CPU diagnostic, not paired improvement or game FPS.
verification.source_boundary: Previous complete manifest plus new instruments.rs; documentation/evidence edits outside compiled inputs. No asset or dependency changes.
verification.focused_checks: Three core read-model tests, two native instrument/provenance tests, session-only UI test and extended actual-adapter flight-deck fixture passed before the final full gate run.
verification.numerical_bounds: Own epochs 0 and 12345 seconds over Thessa and Nereid: altitude <0.001 m, velocity <0.001 m/s and circular-apsis <0.02 m absolute errors. Proper-load regression pins zero-force free fall to 0 g and one standard-gravity non-gravitational force to 1 g within 1e-12. No new numerical physics model.
verification.hardware: AMD Radeon 880M Graphics / RADV STRIX1 / Vulkan / Mesa 26.2.4-arch1.1

limitations: No target/maneuver semantic inputs, inertial/orbit/target attitude frames, FDAI rate/error needles or guidance panel
No foreign-body surface rotation/air/terrain provider; body-relative fallback is explicit
No authoritative air/force/resource wire extension; absent remote fields stay unavailable
Instrument preferences are HUD-session-only, reset on recreation; native arbitrary instrument-body selection is not introduced
No OS-level input injection, independent blind aesthetic/usability acceptance, Metal/WebGPU execution or remote CI claim
CPU diagnostic is scoped read-model cost, not a paired improvement, solver throughput or game FPS
Bevy retirement remains incomplete; flight/event fixtures, remaining optics/render consumers and packaging/tooling still need replacement
